name: Concorde Antares
address: 1 and 26/2, Chikkabettahalli Village, Yelahanka Hobli, Bengaluru, Karnataka
description: Concorde Antares is a high-rise apartment development at Chikkabettahalli, marketed within the Vidyaranyapura-Yelahanka area. Concorde describes 592 homes across seven acres, with a large open-space component and a dedicated clubhouse. The project includes apartment and duplex-penthouse formats, bringing a range of home sizes into a landscape-led community setting.

faqs.question: Where exactly is Concorde Antares located?
faqs.answer: 1 and 26/2, Chikkabettahalli Village, Yelahanka Hobli, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560097. The listed locality is a search category; use the exact village and project entrance.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: 2 BHK, 3 BHK, 3 BHK Penthouse, 4 BHK. Documented saleable/super built-up plan areas span 988–2443 sq ft. The layout table identifies each area basis and applicable phase.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: ₹1.15 Cr* Onward. The pricing record identifies the source and quoted configuration. Unpriced formats are excluded from the reference range; a current cost sheet is needed for the selected unit. Applicable charges are itemised separately by the source.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: Under construction. Published timeline: December 2027. This is a published schedule/status reference, not a fresh contractual handover confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Swimming Pool, Kids Play Area, Multi Purpose Court, Golf Course, Senior Citizen Area, Kids Pool. 50+ CP-marketed amenities. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: Seven acres with 592 homes G plus 16 floor arrangement 81 percent open space reported by Concorde. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
